SEARCH
Module org.maxicp
Package org.maxicp.search.blackbox

Class ModelStructureAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
org.maxicp.search.blackbox.ModelStructureAnalyzer
public final class ModelStructureAnalyzer extends Object
Generic, problem-independent structural analyzer for a constraint model.

Inspects the constraint hypergraph, functional equality definitions, and objective AST to derive:

  • Primary vs. secondary (functionally defined or degree-≤1 objective-slack) decision variables,
  • Initial structural variable weights and primal constraint-graph adjacency lists,
  • Per-variable objective polarities (-1 prefer min, +1 prefer max, 0 neutral),
  • Dominated degree-≤1 table-slack variables that can be assigned their optimal bound once primary variables are fixed.
